Has China finally built a real luxury car to take on the likes of Range Rover and Bentley?! 
Mat’s over in Dubai, and he’s got his hands on the Yangwang U8! It’s a colossal SUV packed with tech and luxury features, but does it offer enough to take on the established elite?! Let’s take a closer look… 

Starting with the design, it’s clear that Yangwang has taken inspiration from one very recognisable luxury car - the Land Rover Defender! Looking at the car from the side, the overall look and shape have clearly been ‘borrowed’ from the Defender. The shape of the body panels and the door mirrors was clearly inspired by Land Rover, and the same can be said for the spare wheel position at the rear of the car. However, at the front end, Yangwang has clearly gone in a different direction, with a huge grille flanked either side by angled headlights that give it a load of presence on the road! 

Step in
title: Why this Chinese ‘Rolls-Royce’ is better than the real thing
